edges.description: README points at the HTTP entry as the place to start.
Send route delegates to the create orchestrator.
Inbound route applies the signer event.
Reject invalid title / signers / expiry before side effects.
Unlock the first ORDER group or every PARALLEL signer.
Stamp default fields onto each signer.
Persist the request before reminders fire.
Advance ORDER after a completed signature.
Function export forwards to the dispatcher singleton.
Retry export forwards to the dispatcher.
Inbound events are re-emitted to subscribers.
Inbound events are audited as the signer.
Filter is applied on the stored rows.

tour.title: Start at the map
tour.description: The fixture README and shared types name the six e-sign modules. Understand Anything always starts a tour at the documents and domain types so you learn vocabulary before call graphs.

tour.title: HTTP entry — send a request
tour.description: POST /v1/signature_request/send is the requester door. The route is a thin wrap; the interesting work lives one hop down in createSignatureRequest.

tour.title: Create request orchestrates the send
tour.description: createSignatureRequest validates, then fans out to routing, field prep, the store, reminders, audit, and the sent webhook. This is the hub of the graph — change it and almost every layer lights up.
tour.languageLesson: The function is an orchestrator: it calls collaborators instead of embedding their rules.

tour.title: Signer routing / order
tour.description: ORDER keeps group 2 pending until group 1 signs. PARALLEL marks every signer awaiting. nextEligibleSigner is what a countersign ceremony depends on.

tour.title: Field prep
tour.description: Each signer gets signature, date, and initials. bindFieldsToSigners fail-closes if a field points at a missing signer — important when routing ids change.

tour.title: Reminders
tour.description: Cadence is [1, 3, 7] days. sendDueReminders writes reminder.sent audit rows and triggers signature_request.reminder.sent webhooks. This is the sample change with the widest cross-layer blast radius.

tour.title: Webhooks
tour.description: Outbound emit + retry, plus inbound viewed/signed/declined. Completing a reminder or a sign always leaves a delivery row the audit trail can cite.

tour.title: Audit trail
tour.description: Every state change appends. GET audit is how ops and compliance reconstruct who did what. If a send-path module stops calling appendAudit, this layer goes quiet — and the test suite should fail.

tour.title: Tests pin the blast radius
tour.description: /understand-diff follows tested_by edges from a changed file. The six fixture tests are the suite a reviewer should re-run after a reminder, routing, or webhook change.
